_comment_1: SAP BTP XSUAA security descriptor for ASK. Replaces the one archived from the Cloud Foundry era, which named a different application, declared scopes ASK cannot read, and pointed its redirect URIs at an approuter that no longer exists.
_comment_2: THE APPLICATION NAME STARTS WITH `ask.` AND THAT IS NOT COSMETIC. The token validator keeps only scopes beginning with `ask.` and then takes what follows the last dot (ask-admin-api/auth/validator.py, _extract_roles_xsuaa). XSUAA renders $XSAPPNAME in a token as <xsappname>!t<tenant>, so `ask.platform` yields `ask.platform!t123.ask-admin`, which passes the filter and resolves to the role `ask-admin`. An xsappname without that prefix yields scopes the validator skips: the user signs in perfectly and then gets 403 everywhere, because ASK reads zero roles. That is exactly what the archived descriptor would have produced.
_comment_3: The scope names ARE the role names, spelled exactly as the code checks them. ask-admin is required by every ASK Studio route and by the admin API; ask-user is the default that reaches ASK Chat and sees an access-denied screen in Studio. These two are the whole list (ask-setup/src/pages/IdentityProviderPage.tsx, KNOWN_ROLES).
_comment_4: REPLACE <CLUSTER_DOMAIN> BEFORE CREATING THE INSTANCE, in all three redirect URIs, for example ff90b8d.kyma.ondemand.com. Each SPA completes its sign-in at <origin>/login/callback (see each app's src/auth/config.ts). A URI that is not listed here stops the sign-in with `redirect_uri` rejected AFTER the password has been typed, which is the same failure mode the Keycloak realm has and the reason the runbook probes it with curl before involving a person.
description: Onibex ASK: authorization for ASK Studio, ASK Chat and ASK Setup

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ask-admin
scopes.description: Author and publish the semantic layer, and administer the platform

role-templates.name: ASKAdministrator
role-templates.description: Full access: ASK Studio, ASK Setup and the admin API

role-templates.name: ASKUser
role-templates.description: Ask questions in ASK Chat. No access to ASK Studio

role-collections.name: ASK Administrator
role-collections.description: Assign in the BTP cockpit to whoever curates the semantic layer

role-collections.name: ASK User
role-collections.description: Assign in the BTP cockpit to everyone who only asks questions
